verificationRecords.detail: Unified service and workspace consume one run ID.
Engineering model edits produce stale state.
View-state changes do not produce stale state.
Failed and cancelled runs preserve the last success.
Hash-qualified current state is reconstructible from the store.
Legacy Phase 7 records migrate without result loss.
Out-of-order older results cannot replace a newer success.
Six workspace modes share one normalized store.
Tree, viewport, and inspector share object-ID selection.
The normalized 1280x720 layout retains a 600px center pane.
Workspace updates are observable and layout state is separate from project data.
The index bridge mounts the real six-tab workspace and keeps batch results inside the workspace.
The integrated batch executes six elastic cases without touching nonlinear analysis.
